steps.message: Hi there! I’m Mr. Ghost, and I’ll be your math guide.

steps.message: In Ficademy, you’ll learn by playing. We use flashcards, quizzes, and even geometry challenges.

steps.message: Whenever you encounter something worth saving, a 'save fact' button appears on the bottom panel.

factData.text2: The slope of a horizontal line is always 0.

steps.message: Just click on it and then you'll find everything important in your FactSheets.

steps.message: Finally, you can also switch course using the dropdown menu. Whenever you're done with the tutorials, feel free to switch to the real math!
